metric_definitions.image_score: 99.9th percentile of anomaly map for map-based methods
metric_definitions.image_f1max: maximum F1 over all image-score thresholds within each category, then category macro
metric_definitions.pixel_f1max: maximum F1 over pixel-score thresholds using 65,536-bin histograms
metric_definitions.pixel_ap: histogram approximation of average precision with 65,536 bins
metric_definitions.aupro_0_05: normalized area under PRO for pixel FPR <= 0.05

important: No backbone retraining or new feature extraction is performed.
Blank values mean the saved method output does not support that metric or the required local artifact is absent.
Image-only historical score methods are not assigned fabricated pixel/region metrics.
